text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So I just have to ask the quiz questions
about
Tomakomai, right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yup, I wanna practice until I can answer
them all
at any time. I'm pretty sure I've
got that page
down... Just need to
check!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay, here we go—question one! Name
three
Class B rivers that run through
Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Nice job! Question two! In what year was
Lake
Utonai designated as a national
wildlife
sanctuary?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Exactly right! Question three! ...What's

Tomakomai's feng shui power spot?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Umm... Tarumaesan Shrine? It's an
amazing
place—Mt. Tarumae's been
enshrined as a sacred
mountain since
long ago!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hang on a sec, I don't remember a
question like
that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Sorry! I just figured I could get
some quick
info that way!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So it's Tarumaesan Shrine, huh? I guess I
know
where my next vacation will be. ♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
H-heeey! You're supposed to help me
study!
